text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Looks like summer camp is over...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, along with the necessity of keeping
the sun's
rays at bay. It was a good
summer, though. And...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
King, Sei, and I are off to the Kikuka
Sho.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And me and Grass are off to the
Mainichi Okan!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
El, surely you understand who it is we're
up
against, correct?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... An awesome champion. Someone
that no
one can keep up with...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
But I'll catch up to her...
If she's the sea,
then
beyond her lies the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I won't wish you the best, El. I need to
focus on
myself if I want to prove to be a
worthy
opponent.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Then... I'll beat both of ya! You and
Suzuka are
both goin' down!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A three-way battle between champion
and
challengers. This fall is looking to be
much more
intense than I thought.
